blocks.source: Source: Greater Vancouver REALTORS®, MLS® Home Price Index, September 2026 (released October 2, 2026). The benchmark is the board’s modelled price for a typical home of this type, not an average of sales. The index sets January 2005 at 100. Changes are as published; the text below calls a change a rise or fall only at 1.5% or more.

blocks.text: Burnaby East: the townhomes benchmark was $857,900 in September 2026. Over the past year it fell 1.7%; over three months it was little changed (-0.7%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move); over the last month it was little changed (+0.6%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). Longer term, over 3 years it fell 5.6%; over 5 years it rose 16.2%; over 10 years it rose 60.2%. Burnaby North: the townhomes benchmark was $880,400 in September 2026. Over the past year it fell 4.7%; over three months it fell 2.6%; over the last month it was little changed (-0.9%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). Longer term, over 3 years it fell 5.0%; over 5 years it rose 10.3%; over 10 years it rose 58.9%. Burnaby South: the townhomes benchmark was $942,100 in September 2026. Over the past year it fell 4.9%; over three months it was little changed (-1.4%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move); over the last month it was little changed (+0.9%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). Longer term, over 3 years it fell 8.4%; over 5 years it rose 8.0%; over 10 years it rose 46.5%.
Townhomes against other home types in Burnaby

Burnaby East: the townhomes benchmark of $857,900 sits $837,000 below the detached houses benchmark of $1,694,900 (51% of it) and $149,800 above the apartments (condos) benchmark of $708,100 (121% of it). Burnaby North: the townhomes benchmark of $880,400 sits $928,100 below the detached houses benchmark of $1,808,500 (49% of it) and $218,000 above the apartments (condos) benchmark of $662,400 (133% of it). Burnaby South: the townhomes benchmark of $942,100 sits $952,500 below the detached houses benchmark of $1,894,600 (50% of it) and $219,100 above the apartments (condos) benchmark of $723,000 (130% of it).

blocks.text: Before you buy townhomes in Burnaby
Jared checks these with you on the exact address before you write an offer:

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a townhome in Burnaby?
faq.a: The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for townhomes in Burnaby (Burnaby East) was $857,900 in September 2026, a modelled price for a typical home and not an average of sales.

faq.q: Did townhome prices fall in Burnaby?
faq.a: Over the past year the benchmark fell 1.7%. Over three months it was little changed (-0.7%, under the 1.5% we need before calling it a move). A change under 1.5% is not described as a rise or fall.

faq.q: Is Burnaby a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in Burnaby had a sales ratio of 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market, and condos and townhomes 11%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many townhomes are for sale in Burnaby?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the townhomes in Burnaby that match what you want.

faq.q: Can Jared alert me when townhomes come up in Burnaby?
faq.a: Yes. Tell him the area, price range and must-haves and he will alert you the day a match is listed.

faq.q: Where can I see all Burnaby homes?
faq.a: The Burnaby homes for sale page covers every home type, and the Burnaby market stats page has the monthly figures.
Jared is a REALTOR® and Personal Real Estate Corporation with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, working across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. You can call or text him at 604-928-1361.
